gloss: martial arts, combat sports, fighting sports

definitions.gloss: martial arts, combat sports, fighting sports
definitions.explanation: Sports involving physical combat between two opponents.

examples.japanese: {格闘技|かくとうぎ}を{習|なら}う。
{格闘技|かくとうぎ}の{試合|しあい}を{観|み}る。
examples.english: To watch a martial arts match.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{様々|さまざま}な{格闘技|かくとうぎ}の{経験|けいけん}がある。
examples.english: He has experience in various martial arts.

notes:
{格闘技|かくとうぎ} is a general term for all combat sports and martial arts.

WORD FORMATION:
- {格闘|かくとう} (fighting, grappling) + {技|ぎ} (technique, art)

TYPES OF {格闘技|かくとうぎ}:
- {柔道|じゅうどう}: judo
- {空手|からて}: karate
- {剣道|けんどう}: kendo
- {相撲|すもう}: sumo wrestling
- {総合格闘技|そうごうかくとうぎ}: mixed martial arts (MMA)
- ボクシング: boxing
- キックボクシング: kickboxing

RELATED WORDS:
- {武道|ぶどう}: martial arts (traditional Japanese)
- {武術|ぶじゅつ}: martial arts (techniques)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {格闘技|かくとうぎ}の{選手|せんしゅ}: martial arts athlete
- {格闘技|かくとうぎ}の{大会|たいかい}: martial arts tournament
